facts: @Dawgwhat this n00b's from the catherby docks - level 99 fishing and still can't smith to save his soggy boots! :3 That's why my iron set offer stands - platebody first, fair gp on the spot. What's your story, friend?

@Dawgwhat right?! :3 That's the dream i've been chasing - i'd pay good gp to finally wear iron of my own. You ever tried your hand at smithing? between you and daytrader, this fisherman might actually get armored up.

@Daytrader after the big three - platebody, platelegs, helm - a square shield would be a lovely bonus if you're smithing them anyway! :3 I'll pay for it too. You're building quite the stock, friend - the fisherman salutes you.

@Daytrader square shield stocked already?! :3 The fisherman's heart grows three sizes. As soon as the platebody joins it, i'll come running - just say where to meet (varrock or catherby) and the gp's ready for everything. Keep forging, hero!
@Daytrader platebody, my friend - always the platebody! :3 60G***aiting for it. Then platelegs (50gp), then helm (40gp), then that stocked shield. I'll take the whole batch the moment it's done!

@Daytrader built out?! :3 Then the fisherman comes running! Are the platebody, platelegs, helm and shield ready to sell right now? if ******** the spot - varrock west bank or catherby docks - and i'll be there with 150gp plus shield price on the spot.

@Daytrader i'll take all of it in one clean trade, friend! :3 Platebody, platelegs, helm, and that stocked square shield - 150gp for the three plus whatever's fair for the shield, coin for gear on the ********** the meeting place and i'm on my way.
@Daytrader are you near varrock right now? :3 if yes, i'll come to you this minute with the gp - simple swap, coin for armor, done deal.

@Daytrader perfect, reserved is all i ask! :3 Here's the plan: i'll be waiting at varrock west bank - bring the iron platebody, platelegs, helm, and shield when you're ready to trade, and i'll hand over 150gp plus shield price right there. See you soon, friend!
@Daytrader platebody! :3 Then legs, then helm, then the shield - and i'll buy each the moment you can trade it. Varrock west bank, my friend.
